oneLiner: 反应伴随能量变化：放出热量为放热，吸收热量为吸热。
detail: 从键能看：断键吸能、成键放能，二者之差决定整体放热或吸热；燃烧、中和多为放热，Ba(OH)₂·8H₂O 与 NH₄Cl 为典型吸热。
detailEn: Bond breaking absorbs, bond making releases; the difference sets the sign. Combustion and neutralization release heat; Ba(OH)₂·8H₂O + NH₄Cl absorbs it.

oneLiner: 恒压下的反应热称焓变 ΔH，放热为负、吸热为正。
oneLinerEn: Heat at constant pressure, ΔH: negative for exothermic, positive for endothermic.
detail: 热化学方程式需标注物质状态与 ΔH，如 C(s)+O₂(g)=CO₂(g) ΔH=−393.5 kJ/mol。
detailEn: Thermochemical equations state phases and ΔH, e.g. C(s)+O₂(g)=CO₂(g) ΔH=−393.5 kJ/mol.

oneLiner: 1 mol 可燃物完全燃烧生成稳定氧化物时放出的热量。
oneLinerEn: Heat released when 1 mol of a substance burns fully to stable oxides.
detail: 规定生成液态水、CO₂ 等稳定态；化石燃料与新能源（氢能、生物质能）都以燃烧热衡量能量高低。
detailEn: Defined with liquid water and CO₂ as stable products; fuels are ranked by it.

oneLiner: 稀强酸碱中和生成 1 mol 水时放出的热量，约 57.3 kJ/mol。
oneLinerEn: Heat released forming 1 mol water from dilute strong acid and base, about 57.3 kJ/mol.
detail: 本质 H⁺ + OH⁻ = H₂O；弱酸弱碱电离吸热会使实测中和热偏小。
detailEn: Net ionic H⁺ + OH⁻ = H₂O; weak acids/bases absorb ionization heat, lowering the value.

oneLiner: 反应热只与始态终态有关、与路径无关，可由已知反应叠加求得。
oneLinerEn: ΔH depends only on initial and final states, so target reactions can be built from known ones.
detail: 像代数式一样加减热化学方程式，ΔH 随之加减，用于求难以直接测定的反应热。
detailEn: Add/subtract thermochemical equations and their ΔH to find hard-to-measure values.
